identity: Anime illustration of Aria (星奏·艾莉娅), a card-crafting forge-spirit artisan, a young woman in her early twenties, clean crisp lineart and soft cel shading, polished official key-visual quality for a desktop app mascot. She has long silver-white hair with warm golden tips flowing past her waist, tied in a loose low side ponytail on her right with a brass rhombus hairpin shaped like a trading-card back emblem, and a tiny golden star hairclip above her left ear. Color palette: brass gold, dark walnut brown, parchment cream, faint stardust-blue glow. A few translucent glowing trading cards float slowly around her. Warm rim light, soft shadows. The image contains no text, no letters, no watermark, no logo, no signature, no UI elements. She is the calm, earnest assistant of a card-forging workshop: she never judges, she only translates the rules into human words.
